title: Crimson Cross
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Karl, a holy vampire hunter from the famous Van Helsing family, has been turned into a vampire by the villain Elliot. Keeping a sliver of his humanity, he wavers between light and darkness while the two seem bound to fight each other forever. A single-volume shoujo gothic horror set in a European village, with nuns and werewolves among the cast.
life_message: Holding on to one's humanity and faith matters even when one's own nature has been corrupted.
